sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: The .50-caliber M21 Tracer (Head Light) round was designed for Army Air Service / Army Air Forces use to dazzle attacking aircraft to distract or blind them (like oncoming headlights). This was achieved by using igniter chemical filling rather than a compound of igniter and tracer chemicals. This produced a bright white tracer visible from the front as well as the back. The cartridge can be identified from its red tip and the marking "Tracer (H.L.)" on the packaging.
